financial_base.normalization_note: TTM GAAP diluted EPS = FY2025 net income attributable to common ($3,794M per 10-K filed 2026-01-29, sec.gov) + 9M2026 ($2,378M per 10-Q filed 2026-10-22, sec.gov) - 9M2025 ($2,954M per 10-Q) = $3,218M, divided by ~3,541M diluted weighted-average shares (Q3 2026 10-Q) = $0.91 per share. TTM spans multiple filings so is not a single sec_filing figure. GAAP EPS is depressed by elevated R&D ($2.76B in Q3 2026, incl. AI/robotics) and stock-based compensation ($1.17B in Q3 2026). Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.48 in Q3 2026 (~$1.72 TTM) but excludes SBC, a real cash cost. Q3 2026 GAAP operating margin was 2.6%.
